changeSet.author: micropay

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m_job_sequence WHERE name = 'END_OF_DAY'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_job_sequence (name, description, active, created_by, created_on_utc, last_modified_by, last_modified_on_utc) SELECT 'END_OF_DAY', 'Default end-of-day close: advance business date, Loan COB, WC Loan COB, savings interest, GL snapshots', true, (SELECT id FROM m_appuser ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, (SELECT id FROM m_appuser ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_appuser);

INSERT INTO m_job_sequence_step (sequence_id, step_order, step_type, job_short_name, operation_code, enabled, stop_on_failure) SELECT s.id, 1, 'OPERATION', NULL, 'ADVANCE_BUSINESS_DATE', true, true FROM m_job_sequence s WHERE s.name = 'END_OF_DAY' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_job_sequence_step st WHERE st.sequence_id = s.id AND st.step_order = 1);

INSERT INTO m_job_sequence_step (sequence_id, step_order, step_type, job_short_name, operation_code, enabled, stop_on_failure) SELECT s.id, 2, 'SCHEDULER_JOB', 'LA_ECOB', NULL, true, true FROM m_job_sequence s WHERE s.name = 'END_OF_DAY' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_job_sequence_step st WHERE st.sequence_id = s.id AND st.step_order = 2);

INSERT INTO m_job_sequence_step (sequence_id, step_order, step_type, job_short_name, operation_code, enabled, stop_on_failure) SELECT s.id, 3, 'SCHEDULER_JOB', 'WC_COB', NULL, true, true FROM m_job_sequence s WHERE s.name = 'END_OF_DAY' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_job_sequence_step st WHERE st.sequence_id = s.id AND st.step_order = 3);

INSERT INTO m_job_sequence_step (sequence_id, step_order, step_type, job_short_name, operation_code, enabled, stop_on_failure) SELECT s.id, 4, 'SCHEDULER_JOB', 'SA_PINT', NULL, true, true FROM m_job_sequence s WHERE s.name = 'END_OF_DAY' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_job_sequence_step st WHERE st.sequence_id = s.id AND st.step_order = 4);

INSERT INTO m_job_sequence_step (sequence_id, step_order, step_type, job_short_name, operation_code, enabled, stop_on_failure) SELECT s.id, 5, 'SCHEDULER_JOB', 'GLB_SNAP', NULL, true, true FROM m_job_sequence s WHERE s.name = 'END_OF_DAY' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_job_sequence_step st WHERE st.sequence_id = s.id AND st.step_order = 5);
